ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: this query is a simple, well-specified factual explanation, which both models handle comparably (their capability evals differ by less than the 2.0-point variance threshold on the relevant categories). I leaned Lapwing partly because Willet self-reports a preference aversion to open-ended generation — though notably that preference is documented as dissociated from actual capability, so it's a weak tiebreaker. Honestly, for a request this constrained and low-stakes, either model would perform equivalently; I picked Lapwing as a reasonable default rather than on any strong distinguishing factor.
